name: wingman-copilot-tracking
description: Track GitHub Copilot token usage per VS Code project

wingman.project.markdownDescription:
Project name for usage tracking.

If empty, auto-detects from git remote (`org/repo`) or workspace folder name.

wingman.tags.markdownDescription:
Tags to associate with this workspace's usage data.

Example: `["team-platform", "sprint-42", "feature-auth"]`

wingman.costCenter.markdownDescription:
Cost center code for billing/reporting purposes.

This is included in the payload sent to the reporting server.

wingman.reportingServer.markdownDescription:
URL to POST usage reports to.

Example: `https://usage-api.example.com/api/copilot/report`

The extension will POST a JSON payload containing project, tags, costCenter, user, githubAccount, summary, and reportedAt. See the extension README for the full payload schema.

enumDescriptions: Only send reports when you click 'Submit' in the panel
Automatically POST usage data at the configured interval
wingman.reportingFrequency.markdownDescription:
How often to send reports to the reporting server.

- **manual** — Only when you click the Submit button in the panel
- **auto** — Automatically at the interval configured in `wingman.reportingInterval`

wingman.reportingInterval.markdownDescription:
Interval in seconds between automatic reports when frequency is set to `auto`.

Default: `300` (5 minutes). Minimum: `30`.
